caption: Pressure bends the clamped silicon diaphragm. The four implanted resistors, whose relative change at full scale is 0.024, form a bridge that hands 0.12 V to the amplifier and ADC.

spec.title: Piezoresistive pressure sensor
spec.aria: Pressure bending a silicon diaphragm, whose implanted resistors form a bridge that feeds an amplifier and an analog-to-digital converter.
